name: 48 Hours per Second
source:
48 Hours per Second is a visual story novel game about the making of a videogame. Choose the actions and make sure that your game comes out a hit!

[From [url=http://games.softpedia.com/get/Freeware-Games/48-Hours-per-Second.shtml]Softpedia[/url]]
translation:
《每秒四十八小时》是一部关于电子游戏制作的视觉小说。选择你的行动，让自己制作的游戏大获成功吧！

[摘自[url=http://games.softpedia.com/get/Freeware-Games/48-Hours-per-Second.shtml]Softpedia[/url]]
